intro.what: Blinker will learn his signals: a strong blink, a look at his hand, a nod, a head shake and head right. A few short steps, about 2 minutes. No step has a time limit.
intro.setup: Place the phone as for talking: on a stand, facing him, in ordinary light.

camera.ask: The browser asks for the camera. Choose “Allow”.

neutral.title: At rest, facing the screen
neutral.do: Ask him to look calmly at the screen for a few seconds.

blink.title: Strong blink (+1)
blink.do: Ask him for 3 strong blinks (stronger than usual), at his own pace.

handLeft.title: Look at his left hand (+5)
handLeft.do: Ask him to look down at his left hand and back. Twice.
handLeft.say: Look at your left hand and back. Twice.

handRight.title: Look at his right hand
handRight.do: Only if he also looks at his right hand. If not, skip this step: the left is enough.
handRight.say: Look at your right hand and back. Twice.

nod.title: Nod (yes)
nod.do: Ask him to nod the way he answers “yes”. Twice.

shake.title: Head shake (no)
shake.do: Ask him to shake his head the way he answers “no”. Twice.

right.title: Head right (finish)
right.do: Ask him to turn his head to his right, hold it a moment and come back. Twice.
right.say: Turn your head right, hold, and come back. Twice.

calibration.faceNo: No face in view: move the phone or improve the light
calibration.nothingLearnt: No movement was recognized. Check that his face is in view, and try again.
calibration.saved: Calibration saved. Blinker uses it from now on.
